en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Jameel, from Ismail Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Divorce of a pregnant woman is once. So when she places what is in her belly, so she has been irrevocably divorced from him’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn abu Nasr from Jamil from ’Isma‘il al-Ju‘fiy who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Divorce of a pregnant woman is one and when she gives birth she become stranger to him.’”
